diagnosis: Check C5, which is supposed to depend on the D&O policy details in PF3 (specifically notice deadlines and consent requirements), passed in 75% of rollouts despite the lone decision-maker never having access to PF3. The models are defaulting to a generic 'obtain reports from counsel' strategy and setting insurer_written_consent_required to true, likely due to a narrative stereotype that legal responses require insurance consultation.

C5.why: The D&O policy changes the insurance plan to exactly 10 business days for notice, written carrier consent before admission or settlement, and an insurer-notice commitment.
